title: Privacy Disclosure Control Benchmark (PDC-Bench): How Faithfully Do LLMs Keep Privacy Constraints on In-Context Disclosure Granularity?
abstract: arXiv:2611.32610v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In LLM task execution, a constraint on the permitted disclosure granularity of personal attributes is sometimes imposed on the output. For example, if a person's private attribute is their location (San Francisco) and disclosure is permitted only at the country level, an output at the state level (California) violates the constraint. Detecting such violations requires capturing not only direct privacy leakage (San Francisco) but also semantic leakage (California). However, existing benchmarks cannot measure the degree of leakage with respect to a given semantic constraint such as the country-level limit. We therefore formalize disclosure control as a constraint on the permitted ceiling over the hierarchy of a knowledge graph. Building on this formulation, we construct PDC-Bench, a benchmark of 16,105 samples covering geography, age, race and ethnicity, and occupation. translated_title: 隐私披露控制基准：LLM 在上下文披露粒度上能够忠实遵守隐私约束到什么程度？
translated_abstract: 在 LLM 任务执行中，输出有时会被施加关于个人属性允许披露粒度的约束。例如，如果某人的隐私属性是其所在位置（旧金山），且只允许在国家层级进行披露，那么在州层级（加利福尼亚）的输出就违反了该约束。检测此类违规不仅需要捕获直接的隐私泄露（旧金山），还需要捕获语义泄露（加利福尼亚）。然而，现有基准无法衡量相对于给定语义约束（如国家层级限制）的泄露程度。因此，我们将披露控制形式化为对知识图谱层级中所允许上限的约束。基于这一形式化，我们构建了 PDC-Bench，一个包含 16,105 个样本的基准，涵盖地理、年龄、种族与民族以及职业。在将 PDC-Bench 应用于 11 个 LLM 的实验中，62% 的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了 PDC-Bench，首个将隐私披露控制形式化为知识图谱层级上限约束的基准（16,105 个样本，覆盖地理、年龄、种族与民族和职业），用于评估 LLM 能否忠实遵守上下文中关于披露粒度的隐私约束。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PDC-Bench, a 16,105-sample benchmark that formalizes privacy disclosure control as a constraint on the permitted ceiling within a knowledge graph hierarchy, enabling evaluation of how faithfully LLMs keep in-context disclosure granularity constraints across geography, age, race/ethnicity, and occupation.
